t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Kierek, â Nzēm ami, Nze le mandoen umuin mukukuyebanga ti mukukufukiminanga. Tan alià, ekis bumol ba mi ti bungol ba Nze, busui ba mi ti bunvam ba Nze. Kukitene, lo kufuyini ti Nzèm ambēn, kaka Nze mbwes Nzèm, u useresa band mu bigonz, u uzing a mumpil e nzièn mbwes.
